description: Schliffe hooks — trim remote MCP results (Figma, etc.) and large images on PostToolUse, and flag pasted logs / long-conversation context on UserPromptSubmit. These call the `schliffe` binary from PATH (brew/cargo/npm/curl install, then /schliffe-setup); until it is installed they do nothing, instead of failing on every tool call.

hooks.command: command -v schliffe >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec schliffe hook post-tool-use
command -v schliffe >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec schliffe hook user-prompt-submit
